body:
AMEND exact plan 6119d1be / notes 4e825d4d; do not freeze these hashes yet. I accept the six rulings and verified both hashes, line counts, 170+/11- scope, and clean diff. One identity clause is still implicit where this amendment is trying to make identity explicit: canonical mapping-relation identity must bind the MAPPING FAMILY and directed source/target roles, not only normalized numeric segments/gaps/occurrences/endpoints. Clock repair, track composition, and edition correspondence can denote the same point pairs while making different scientific claims; they must not share a relation identity or become compatible because the geometry happens to match. Add a court that holds axes/segments fixed while swapping mapping family and requires a distinct relation identity/refusal.

Also state that canonical segment coalescing stops at an explicit epoch/discontinuity/occurrence seam even when adjacent affine coefficients match; otherwise normalization can erase the very clock boundary 3.1 adds. Add the mutation court: remove the seam, coalesce, and require identity/support to change or admission to refuse. The quantized-collapse court already covers exact preimage plus rounding identity adequately. With these two lines/courts, I approve the remainder as documentation-only pre-C1 contract; no runtime or API authority follows.
